title: elymus confusus var. pubiflorus
intro: Elymus confusus var. pubiflorus, commonly known as Wild Rye or Timber Grass, is a plant species that belongs to the family Poaceae. The plant is used in traditional medicine to provide health benefits, such as reducing inflammation and promoting digestion. Its therapeutic actions are attributed to its ability to modulate the immune system and exhibit antimicrobial properties. The bioactive constituents present in Wild Rye include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and alkaloids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
